description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger instead due to With Great Power....
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

uses.name: With Great Power . . .
uses.cardState: attached to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger
